blurb: LEAPTRADER_ is a retail options educator and practitioner on X who focuses on premium-selling strategies — primarily the wheel (cash-secured puts into covered calls), theta-optimised short options at 30–45 days to expiration, and longer-dated LEAPS positions as equity proxies. The account functions as a public trading journal and educational feed, with posts covering delta targeting, DTE management, and position-sizing for income-oriented portfolios. The handle's namesake instrument, LEAPS (Long-Term Equity AnticiPation Securities), reflects an interest in marrying patient, long-horizon equity exposure with active premium collection on shorter-dated options.
credibility_note: LEAPTRADER_ presents as a self-directed retail trader and informal educator rather than a licensed advisor or registered fund manager. No audited performance record or disclosed AUM is publicly available. Posts are educational in tone and consistent with standard tastytrade/thetagang methodology.
